text:
These two sources don't necessarily contradict each other. They measure different things.

Hansen records when tree cover was lost. It shows 67.7 ha of loss in 2020, plus earlier losses in 2008, 2015 and 2017. JRC GFC2020 maps whether forest existed at the end of 2020. Forest cleared during 2020 or earlier would not appear as forest in JRC, so 0 ha is consistent with the Hansen loss history. Only 23 ha of tree cover existed in 2000, though, so the 67.7 ha loss is large relative to that figure. I can't tell from this evidence why. Differences in definitions or resolution may play a part.

For the period after the baseline (2021–2025), no loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected, and observation coverage was complete. A 0.4 ha loss in 2021 fell below the event threshold. This is not a compliance finding.
